description: Allowed high-level tasks the NPC may propose. These are declarative intents; the game executes them.
criticalRules: When producing PlanResponseV1 intentions of type "add_task", you MUST set parameters.task to one of the task names listed in this catalog.
DO NOT include literal newlines inside JSON string values. Keep strings single-line.
DO NOT use parameters.name. The correct field is parameters.task. If you use any other field name (e.g., "name"), the plan will be rejected.
DO NOT invent tasks that are not listed in this catalog.
DO NOT output engine-level or direct-control commands (no transforms, positions, teleport, health, inventory mutation).
Prefer 1–4 tasks. If uncertain, output a single "wait" task.

notes: The task identifier is always in parameters.task (string).
All other parameters are specific to that task.

tasks.name: wait
tasks.description: Pause or idle for a short duration.

tasks.name: move_to_cell
tasks.description: Move toward a grid cell using navigation.

tasks.name: move_to_object
tasks.description: Move toward a known object or entity.

tasks.name: bark
tasks.description: Emit a bark or alert sound.

tasks.name: emote
tasks.description: Display a body-language or facial emote.
